info.title: Signal Sentinel Scanner
info.description: Fast, deterministic, offline-capable first-pass security aid for MCP servers and Agent Skill authors. 32 security rules aligned with OWASP Agentic AI Top 10 (ASI) and OWASP Agentic Skills Top 10 (AST). v2.5.1 is a false-positive remediation patch for the skill-scanning rules (shebang lines, .env mentions, meta tags, defensive "exfiltrate" prose, JS property access, identifier-name collisions, and emoji ZWJ sequences), informed by a real-world 65-skill review. v2.5.0 tracked the MCP 2026-07-28 specification (stateless core, legacy transport/protocol currency notice), added a skill supply-chain rule for unpinned GitHub dependency references (SkillJacking), recognised Universal Skill Format risk_tier and permissions.deny_write fields, and consolidated the full v2.4.x backlog: orchestrator-agnostic scope filtering, phrase-based detection for MCP and skill rule families, corrected OWASP AST10 taxonomy alignment, canonical skill identity for suppression/scope matching, and behavioural auth/TLS/non-MCP-endpoint probing.
